facts.fact: The Core plan includes 250 bulk message credits per month.
The Pro plan includes 500 bulk message credits per month, and the Signature plan's bulk message credits are custom.
The Core plan includes 5 phone numbers, the Pro plan includes 15 phone numbers, and the Signature plan's number count is custom.
Each phone number beyond those included in a plan costs $5 per month.
A base 10DLC fee of $5 per month is charged for all US locations.
facts.quote: A base 10DLC fee of $5/month is charged for all US locations.

facts.fact: High-Volume Carrier-Verified Messaging costs $15 per month on the Core plan, is included in Pro, and is custom on Signature.
Higher bulk message limits than the plan default are available.
Businesses in the HVAC industry must contact sales to get applicable pricing on every plan.
facts.quote: HVAC businesses should contact sales for applicable pricing

facts.fact: Podium's own marketing claims AI Employee can help customers get 30% more sales (vendor claim, not independently verified on the page).
facts.quote: Get 30% _more_ sales with AI Employee, _even_ while you sleep.

facts.fact: Contacts, one-to-one text messages, conversation history, and team members are unlimited on all three plans.
The Core plan offers a Phone Systems add-on that is available for purchase.
